_comment: Copy to card_accounts.local.json (not in git). dropFolders: where you save Chase, Discover or Capital One card downloads (QFX / OFX and Chase's Chase1234_Activity….csv anywhere in them; other CSV files in a sub-folder named by the card's code). accounts: a card number's last four digits → the card's code in MxAcctMGR (a card's own last four digits, set in MxAcctMGR, map it too).
